title: Design System: Syed Abdul Rahman Al-Haddad Portfolio

display.purpose: Compressed name lines with root-relative and viewport sizing; 82% width, calc(0.76rem + 12vw) on mobile, wrapping at larger text sizes.

headline.purpose: Section headings and the mobile email scale.

title.purpose: Project disclosure names; 85% width, mobile lead size.

lead.purpose: Introductions, results, roles, skill groups, and recognition titles; mobile size 1.375rem, component weights vary.

body.purpose: Running copy with a common 65ch measure cap in detail columns.

label.purpose: Dates, captions, table column headings, technical stacks, and footer; functional labels only.

contact-display.purpose: Email begins on two lines and wraps at larger text sizes; 105% width on desktop and 82% on mobile.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Shared transform easing from the source custom property.

motion.name: control-state
motion.purpose: Button/filter transform and background-color feedback; scaling only with no reduced-motion preference. Press opacity and summary background feedback remain immediate.

motion.name: name-arrive
motion.purpose: Name lines translate from 75% vertically to zero; no-preference media query only.

motion.name: second-name-delay
motion.purpose: Delay on the second masked name line.

motion.name: content-arrive
motion.purpose: Project diagrams/email move from translateY(12px), opacity 0.9 to rest; once, skipped for keyboard and reduced motion.

motion.name: detail-arrive
motion.purpose: Experience detail moves from translateX(10px), opacity 0.9 to rest; once, skipped for keyboard and reduced motion.

motion.name: portrait-arrive
motion.purpose: Portrait moves from scale(1.015), opacity 0.9 to rest; once, skipped for keyboard and reduced motion.

motion.name: contact-arrow-hover
motion.purpose: Fine-pointer hover translates the email arrow by 5px right and 5px up only when motion is allowed.

motion.name: disclosure-chevron
motion.purpose: Reversible disclosure indicator rotation when motion is allowed; immediate for keyboard focus and reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
The recorded direction is expressed through Archivo variable type, cobalt ink, warm sand fields, and square controls. Oversized identity and contact type frame an engineering portfolio whose project index opens into specific results and architecture diagrams. The title is the direction label already recorded in the surface brief; no additional qualitative preference or comp approval is implied.

The implemented system is spacious at the section level and more compact within project records. Color inversion separates experience and contact; tonal changes organize the other fields. The existing portrait and three original architecture diagrams provide the visual evidence. This document describes the shipped rules observed in `styles.css`, `index.html`, `script.js`, and browser captures, with product facts maintained separately in `PRODUCT.md`.
keyCharacteristics: One variable sans-serif family with strong changes in size, weight, and width.
Cobalt text and controls across sand and chalk surfaces.
Flat, square fields with hierarchy created by type, spacing, and tone.
Native project disclosures, explicit filters, and progressive enhancement.
Short state feedback and restrained, optional one-time entrances.

rules.name: The Inverted Field Rule
rules.body: On the cobalt experience and contact fields, text, links, icons, and focus outlines inherit sand; selection reverses that pair.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Use Archivo's observed weight and width axes for hierarchy; retain the existing sans-serif fallback and browser text semantics.

rules.name: The Flat Field Rule
rules.body: Continue the observed tonal hierarchy and square surfaces when adding a related section.

dos: **Do** keep cobalt and sand as the primary text/surface pair and use the recorded inverse pairing on cobalt fields.
**Do** use Archivo's established type roles, square controls, and fluid section gutters.
**Do** preserve native disclosure behavior, visible keyboard focus, accessible labels, and useful content without JavaScript.
**Do** use actual project diagrams and the existing portrait with their source aspect ratios and descriptive alternative text.
**Do** keep motion optional, brief, and limited to the observed state feedback and one-time entrances.
donts: **Don't** turn the functional table headers into a decorative eyebrow pattern.
**Don't** introduce rounded cards, shadows, or blur as default treatments for these flat content fields.
**Don't** hide essential project copy behind JavaScript-only rendering or animate disclosure height.
**Don't** treat generated tonal ramps as an expanded approved palette.
**Don't** describe the unavailable Impeccable engine, FORM gate, or detector as a successful check or a user-approved comp.
